TerraDepth 3D (TerraDepth.tmod) - installing on another computer

Requirements
  - Terraria and tModLoader on Steam (tModLoader is free for Terraria owners).
  - tModLoader 2026.8 or newer: the mod is built for 2026.8.3.
    Start tModLoader from Steam once to let Steam update it.

Installation
  1. Start tModLoader once and close it, so that its folders are created.
  2. Copy TerraDepth.tmod into the Mods folder:
       Windows: Documents\My Games\Terraria\tModLoader\Mods
                (usually C:\Users\<name>\Documents\My Games\Terraria\tModLoader\Mods)
       macOS:   ~/Library/Application Support/Terraria/tModLoader/Mods
                (in Finder: Go > Go to Folder... and paste the path)
       Linux:   ~/.local/share/Terraria/tModLoader/Mods
  3. Start tModLoader > Workshop > Manage Mods.
  4. Enable "TerraDepth 3D" and press Reload Mods.

Worlds and characters (optional)
  To move a world, copy both of its files from the Worlds folder next to Mods:
  <name>.wld and <name>.twld. The 3D data of the world is stored in the .twld file.
  Characters are in the Players folder: <name>.plr and <name>.tplr.

Controls
  WASD - move, mouse - look, X - drop through platforms,
  F5 - first / third person camera, F6 - toggle 3D,
  Left Alt (hold) - free the cursor.
  The mod keys can be rebound in Settings > Controls.
  World depth and render distance are in the mod settings (Mod Configuration).

If the mod does not show up in the list
  - Check the tModLoader version (2026.8 or newer is required).
  - Check that the file is named exactly TerraDepth.tmod and lies directly in the Mods folder.
